title: work-manifest
description: Phase 1 (plan_26072506) INPUT contract consumed by scripts/completion_gate.py. Declares a unit of work's task class, HW/model identity, runtime state, evidence artifact paths, benchmark verdict, and PII scan result. This file is executed, not merely descriptive: scripts/completion_gate.py loads it at runtime and walks every declared keyword (type/required/properties/additionalProperties/enum/const/minimum/minLength/items/$ref) with a small generic Draft-07-subset validator -- there is no second, hand-duplicated copy of these constraints. Strong identity is 6 keys: model, gpu, vllm, quant, topology, tp (compared in full wherever identity is cross-checked -- runtime.identity, and the actual parsed certificate artifact). Certificate identity is NOT self-asserted here (see evidence.certificate) -- trust for certificate identity comes only from parsing the real flat-YAML certificate artifact on disk (scripts/completion_gate.py:parse_flat_certificate), never from manifest-declared fields.

task_class.description: Maps to the required_evidence table in plan_26072506 section 4.4 (scripts/completion_gate.py REQUIRED_EVIDENCE + required_evidence_for()).

runtime.description: Live service state at manifest-authoring time, for runtime-backed task classes (everything except capacity_rejection, which substitutes capacity_rejection for this block entirely). Reaching runtime-ready requires health_ok=true, no oom_killed container, functional_smoke_passed=true, AND identity present matching the top-level identity on all 6 strong fields -- structural shape here is intentionally permissive (all sub-fields optional in the schema); which sub-fields are mandatory for which task_class/state is operational policy enforced in scripts/completion_gate.py, not duplicated schema constraints.

capacity_rejection.description: Substitutes for `runtime` when a task is rejected pre-serve by a deterministic capacity/RAM gate (e.g. Qwen3.5-397B). gate_evidence is a repo-relative path to the raw gate decision (exit code / log); resolved through the same hardened, symlink-rejecting path resolver as evidence.*.path and must be a real non-empty regular file.

conditions.description: Task-class-specific dynamic-evidence-matrix switches (plan_26072506 required behaviors D3, D6). actual_trial: harness_change also requires simlog when true. report_requested: read_only_audit requires evidence.report when true (otherwise empty evidence may terminate at evidence-complete).

evidence.description: One entry per evidence kind. Paths are resolved relative to the manifest file's own directory (never CWD), through a hardened dir_fd/O_NOFOLLOW resolver that rejects symlinks at any path component and enforces the expected filesystem type (regular non-empty file for all kinds except simlog, which must be a real directory). null means 'not produced'. Which keys are REQUIRED for a given task_class/conditions/verdict combination is the dynamic evidence matrix in scripts/completion_gate.py (required_evidence_for()), not a schema-level constraint (JSON Schema draft-07 core keywords -- the only ones this validator implements -- cannot express task_class-conditional requiredness without if/then/else, which is out of scope this phase).

scanned_paths.description: Every evidence path required for the state/promotion being claimed must appear here (compared as literal evidence.<key>.path strings) -- coverage is enforced by scripts/completion_gate.py, not by this schema (schema only constrains item type).

identity.description: Strong identity: 6 keys, all required (quant's value may be null -- e.g. an unquantized/bf16 model -- but the key itself must be present). Cross-checked in full (all 6 fields) wherever identity is compared: runtime.identity against this block, and the actual parsed certificate artifact's mapped fields against this block.

evidenceItem.description: No identity sub-object on any evidence kind, including certificate -- manifest-self-asserted evidence identity cannot establish trust (plan_26072506 required behavior B3). additionalProperties:false makes it a schema violation (invalid-input, exit 2) to even attempt one.
